title: Top Courses To Study at KIIT University

children.text: KIIT University, located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, is renowned for its diverse range of academic programs and holistic approach to education. With a strong emphasis on innovation, research, and industry collaboration, KIIT offers a plethora of courses that cater to the varied interests and career aspirations of students. In this article, we will delve into some of the top courses offered at KIIT University, showcasing the university’s commitment to academic excellence and preparing students for a dynamic future.
Bachelor's in Technology:

At KIIT, the Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) program stands out as a flagship course. The university offers a wide range of engineering disciplines, including Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and many more. The B.Tech program at KIIT provides students with a comprehensive understanding of theoretical foundations and practical skills necessary to excel in the industry. With state-of-the-art laboratories, experienced faculty, and industry collaborations, KIIT equips students with a strong foundation for a successful engineering career.
Bachelor's in Science Nursing:

The Bachelor of Science in Nursing (B.Sc Nursing) program at KIIT University is designed for students passionate about healthcare and patient care. KIIT’s nursing program focuses on developing clinical proficiency, critical thinking, and compassionate care. Through a combination of theoretical knowledge, practical training, and clinical experiences, students gain a deep understanding of healthcare practices, ethical considerations, and the latest advancements in the field. The program prepares students for diverse roles in hospitals, clinics, research institutions, and community health organizations.
Bachelor's in Business Administration:

For those aspiring to become business leaders and entrepreneurs, the Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) program at KIIT offers a comprehensive curriculum. With a focus on building managerial skills, strategic thinking, and an understanding of global business practices, the BBA program equips students with a strong foundation in areas such as finance, marketing, human resources, and operations. The program also emphasizes experiential learning through internships, industry projects, and interactive sessions with industry experts, preparing students for a wide range of managerial roles.
Bachelor's in Film and Television Production:

KIIT University recognizes the growing influence of media and entertainment industries and offers a Bachelor’s program in Film and Television Production. This program provides students with a creative platform to explore various aspects of filmmaking, including direction, cinematography, editing, and screenwriting. With access to state-of-the-art production facilities and guidance from experienced industry professionals, students gain practical skills and industry insights necessary to thrive in the competitive world of film and television.
Bachelor of Architecture:

KIIT University’s Bachelor of Architecture program aims to nurture creative and talented individuals aspiring to shape the built environment. The program emphasizes a holistic approach to architecture, incorporating design thinking, sustainability, and technical expertise. Students engage in studio-based learning, collaborative projects, and field visits, allowing them to develop their design skills and gain practical experience. KIIT’s architecture program prepares students for a rewarding career in architectural design, urban planning, and sustainable development.
Courses Available for International Applicants at KIIT
KIIT lists the programs below for international applicants on its admission website. Durations are as KIIT lists them, checked in October 2026.
Undergraduate and integrated programs

- B.Tech: 4 years. Branches include Computer Science & Engineering, Information Technology, Civil, Electrical, Mechanical (Automobile), Aerospace, Chemical and Mechatronics Engineering, plus Computer Science specializations in Artificial Intelligence, AI and Machine Learning, Cyber Security, Data Science and Internet of Things.
- B.Tech Lateral Entry: 3 years, for Civil, Mechanical, Mechanical (Automobile), Electrical, Electronics & Tele-Communication, Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics & Electrical, and Electronics & Instrumentation.
- Biotechnology Dual Degree (B.Tech and M.Tech): 5 years.
- B.Sc Nursing: 4 years.
- BA LLB, BBA LLB and B.Sc LLB: 5 years.
- BBA: 3 years. BCA: 3 years.
- Bachelor of Architecture: 5 years.
- Bachelor of Design (Fashion/Textile): 4 years.
- Bachelor in Film and Television Production: 3 years.
- Master of Mass Communication (Integrated): 5 years.
- Also listed: B.Sc (Computer Science), B.Com, and B.A. (Hons) in Economics, Sociology and English.
Postgraduate programs

- M.Tech: 2 years, in Electrical, Civil, Mechanical, Electronics & Tele-Communication, Computer Science & Engineering and other specializations.
- MCA: 3 years. MCA (Lateral Entry): 2 years.
- M.Sc Nursing: 2 years. M.Sc Biotechnology / Applied Microbiology: 2 years.
- MBA, MBA (Rural Management) and MBA (Agribusiness Management).
- LLM: 1 year.
- Master of Public Health, Master of Hospital Administration and M.A. (Yoga Therapy): 2 years each.
- Master of Mass Communication: 2 years. Integrated Dual Degree M.Sc–Ph.D.: 5 years. Ph.D.
Eligibility at a glance

- B.Tech (4 years): a pass in 10+2 or equivalent with at least 60% marks in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics taken together, according to the KIITEE 2026 information brochure.
- Other programs: each program sets its own minimum marks in 10+2 (or in the previous degree for postgraduate programs), and some need subjects such as mathematics or English. KIIT lists these program by program on its international eligibility page.
- If you are still taking your qualifying exam, KIIT's international page says you can apply, but you must show your pass certificate on counseling day.
- Age limits, exam years and entrance requirements change each year. The international eligibility page still shows dates from 2019 to 2021, so confirm the current rules with KIIT or with us before you apply.
How to apply

International applicants apply through KIIT's separate international admission page on its KIITEE website, where KIIT publishes the eligibility rules, fees and notices. Check the current rules there before you apply, because they are updated each year.

KIIT University offers an impressive array of courses that cater to diverse academic interests and career aspirations. Whether one seeks to pursue engineering, healthcare, business administration, film and television production, or architecture, KIIT provides a conducive environment for holistic learning and personal growth. With its focus on industry relevance, practical exposure, and nurturing talent, KIIT equips students with the knowledge, skills, and confidence necessary to excel in their chosen fields. Embarking on an educational journey at KIIT University promises a transformative experience that sets the stage for a successful and fulfilling professional career.
